The evidence conflicts. Tenant 3 says the Falcons lead with 16 points, and Tenant 4 says the Wolves lead with 19 points after a points correction.

The "points correction" suggests Tenant 4's note is the more recent and more accurate figure. Tenant 3's figures show the Wolves on 15, and a correction raising them to 19 would put them ahead of the Falcons' 16. The two sources also come from different tenants, so they may not describe the same league. The question gives no tenant, so I can't confirm that, and the correction is the only evidence that explains the discrepancy.
